comparison.ci_scope_note: Intervals resample blocks within each of the 4 test sessions and pool them; they are across-session evidence about the recorded sessions, not about unrecorded days.

discriminator_protocol.note: identical protocol for every method and seed

conditioning_note: The history-conditioned DDPM sees the full 60-second past-context tensor in addition to the two regime aggregates, so its row is not conditioning-matched with the other families, which see the regime aggregates only.

discriminator.note: identical protocol for every method and seed

pareto_table.note: One row per family under the identical protocol. The baseline row is measured; challenger rows are pending until part 2 fills them. The table reports metrics only.

expanded_corpus.peak_memory_note: FF-R08 recorded a per-run allocation delta (0.006 MB), not peak RSS; the run peak RSS of 545.9 MB covers all seven policies, not the DDPM alone, so no per-policy peak is claimed.

run_notes: The run was interrupted once by a runtime restart after the ddpm, vae, and autoregressive checkpoints were saved, and resumed from those checkpoints with no method retrained: the resumed run trained the history-conditioned DDPM and flow matching, generated every family, and scored the comparison. Train losses for the three resumed methods are the values printed by the first run (ddpm 0.1795, vae 0.5666, autoregressive -4.7267); the resumed run lasted 42.0 minutes and the first run about 10 minutes of training before the restart. The recorded FF-R08 DDPM row is kept as a cross-check: the retrained DDPM reads test mean W1 0.1382 against the recorded 0.1376, AUC 0.7337 against 0.7091, and TSTR 0.4763 against 0.5153.

tstr.task: second-half signed-flow direction from first-half feature means

tuning.note: DDPM, autoregressive, history-conditioned DDPM, and flow matching share the same optimizer-step count; the VAE keeps the FF-R08 reference protocol and its step count is recorded here, not assumed equal.
